subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a display-only `label` field across supported channel group-entry config contracts, and which channel entry families are in scope?
rationale: The requested field is a new public configuration surface spanning independently owned channel schemas; its name and scope determine long-term compatibility and must not be inferred from the WhatsApp runtime-name feature.

options.title: Adopt a shared `label` contract
options.body: Add an optional ignored-at-runtime `label` string to the defined set of group-entry schemas, generated metadata, docs, and validation tests.

options.title: Keep metadata channel-specific
options.body: Allow owning channel plugins to introduce display metadata only where their configuration and documentation justify it, without a core-wide contract.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group configuration behavior-only and direct users to an external ID-to-name mapping instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared `label` contract
recommendation.body: Add an optional ignored-at-runtime `label` string to the defined set of group-entry schemas, generated metadata, docs, and validation tests.
